notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
🏆 New Season — New Leaderboard Rules!

Starting this September, the game now has monthly seasons.
At the end of each month, leaderboards will be reset, and results will be archived (with screenshots of the TOP 10).

🔄 How it worked before:

Only your best score was saved.

If you played worse than your record, the leaderboard entry didn’t update.

⚡ How it works now:

Every new attempt is saved.

Even if you score lower than before, that result will replace the previous one.

✨ What this means for you:

Every match matters now.

At the start of each season, everyone has a fair shot at climbing the TOP.

You can keep playing to secure your place at the top.

📅 The September season is already live — jump in and set your new records! 🚀

notes.title: 🔧 Patch 1.0.1 — Community Feedback Fixes & Improvements!
notes.content:
Thanks for all the feedback! I've released update 1.0.1 with fixes and improvements based on your suggestions:

❌ Removed swipe camera controls — they were interfering with gameplay.

⚡ Faster animation when hex blocks return to the generators.

🏆 The "Leaderboard Legend" achievement now unlocks if there are 20 players in the competitive leaderboard instead of 100.

🌐 Fixed a leaderboard display bug: now shows “Hidden” instead of 0 points (this happens when a player’s profile is private and the SDK can’t access their score).

🎨 Skin and map choices are now saved between sessions.

📊 The leaderboard window now opens instantly and shows a loading spinner while fetching data.

🧩 Achievement triggers for Infinite Mode have been updated to work correctly.

Update now and keep chasing those high scores! 💪

notes.title: DEVLOG #2 : Global Update - HEXA WORLD 3D
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508624/c73fb3dd96f02f5b74d217f546194ba991558d2a.jpg[/img]
🎉 Hi Everyone ! Global Update — HEXA WORLD 3D Gets a New Visual Style, UI, and Game Concept!
I’ve completely redesigned the visual style, updated promo icons, refreshed the Steam page, added a brand-new trailer and screenshots, overhauled the interface, and reimagined the core gameplay of HEXA WORLD 3D, turning it from a simple puzzle into a full-fledged adventure with progression, rewards, and a competitive edge!
🔁 New Game Concept — XP, Drops, Boosters, and Unlocks
Now in HEXA WORLD 3D:

🎮 Every action earns you XP — from combos and clearing the board to finishing levels.

📦 After each win, you receive loot — cosmetics, boosters, and even new maps.

🚀 Use boosters to strategically smash towers, unlock blocked cells, and refresh the stack lineup.

🗺️ Unlock locations and skins — build your progression and customize the game to your liking.

🧘 Infinity Mode — Relax Your Way
Want to play with no pressure or timers?
In Infinity Mode, you can choose the field size and shape (hexagon, diamond, triangle, etc.) and simply enjoy peaceful puzzle-solving.

No time limits — just you and the puzzle board.

🏆 Competitive Mode — Now with Three Difficulty Levels
For players who love a challenge:

You have 5 minutes to score as high as possible and climb the leaderboard.

Choose your difficulty:
☑️ Easy — for chill puzzle runs
☑️ Medium — for seasoned players
☑️ Hard — for true puzzle masters

Leaderboards reset monthly!

✨ Redesigned UI and Visual Style
A new cozy sci-fi look: soft colors, clean interface, and an accessible layout for all types of players.

Inventory, map selection, skins, leaderboards, player level — everything is now cleaner, smoother, and more enjoyable to use.

💬 What’s Coming Next?
I’m continuing to expand the game!
Coming soon:

New maps: Halloween, Desert, Space

Additional skins and visual rewards

❤️ Thanks for being part of this journey!
Join the Discord community to chat, share feedback, and help shape the future of the game.

And don’t forget to wishlist HEXA WORLD 3D and leave a review — it really helps the project grow!

notes.title: Devlog #1 – Hello Players! Procedural Generation & Skins Hi everyone, and Skins
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508624/64093a097ff784b3edfc58f0db2e74ff366ba021.png[/img]
Hi everyone, and welcome! 👋
I’m the solo developer behind Hexa World 3D, and this is the very first devlog here on Steam. I wanted to say a quick hello and share what I’ve been working on lately.

HEXA-WORLD-3D is a fast-paced 3D hexagon puzzle game where you compete for high scores in various modes — including endless runs, 5-minute challenges, and procedurally generated levels with progression.

🧠 [b]Procedural Level Generation[/b]
I’ve just finished implementing procedural generation for levels. That means every game session is different — the field layout, locked tiles, available blocks, and even difficulty scale depending on your level and mode.

No more repeating the same layout — each round feels fresh and slightly unpredictable.

🎨 [b]Tile Skins[/b]
I’ve also added visual styles for tiles depending on the map you play on:

❄️ Winter map has icy, soft-looking pieces

🪑 Cozy room features warm and colorful tiles

💼 Office map keeps it clean and minimal

More maps and skins are planned for future updates, possibly including seasonal themes and unlockables as you level up.

🎥 [b]Short Video[/b]
Here’s a short video showcasing a few generated levels and how the tile styles change based on map selection:

[previewyoutube=beyv89ou-q0;full][/previewyoutube]

💬 [b]Let’s Connect[/b]
This is just the beginning! I’ll be posting more devlogs as we move toward launch — and I’d love to hear your thoughts, suggestions, or questions.

Feel free to wishlist the game if it looks fun to you — and stay tuned for the Steam Next Fest demo in June!

Thanks so much for your support!
